name: notfunny.exe
source:
After the collapse of the tower ride in Purgatoria Park, the survivors begin disappearing one by one, as if fate itself is hunting them down. Myra knows it isn’t supernatural — but the legend has already chosen for her: the next victim wears a red jacket. She has only a few days to find the one counting down the meters to death before her own name ends up on the list.

According to the park’s legend, the soul of its dead owner summoned Death itself, and now it walks among the visitors. Myra doesn’t believe in fairy tales, yet the facts stubbornly keep adding up. Or is someone else behind it all?
